crossRefs.note: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,
that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, That they are led out to the day of wrath?
Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;
The ox knows his owner, and the donkey his master’s crib; but Israel doesn’t know. My people don’t consider.”
Yes, the stork in the sky knows her appointed times. The turtledove, the swallow, and the crane observe the time of…

translations.bsb: But ask the animals, and they will instruct you; ask the birds of the air, and they will tell you.
